justification: Inspected core/src/main/resources/examples/TestInner.java and core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestBytecodeLoaderWithInnerClasses.java. TestInner is a small example class: the outer class has only 3 members (constructor, a(), main) and each inner class adds just one constructor and one method; all methods only print messages or chain object creation, so there is no evidence of many responsibilities, large method count, or low cohesion that would justify insufficient modularization.
